subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Indolent B cell lymphomas: follicular lymphoma, marginal zone lymphoma, grading, staging, watchful waiting and chemoimmunotherapy

steps.tx: Follicular lymphoma is the most common indolent non-Hodgkin lymphoma, cytogenetically defined by the hallmark reciprocal translocation **t(14;18)(q32;q21)**. This translocation places the **BCL2** proto-oncogene under the transcriptional control of the immunoglobulin heavy chain IGH enhancer, causing constitutive overexpression of anti-apoptotic BCL2 protein that protects germinal centre B cells from physiological apoptosis.

steps.tx: The validated **Follicular Lymphoma International Prognostic Index** FLIPI stratifies patients into low, intermediate, and high risk tiers based on 5 independent adverse clinical variables: age over 60 years, Ann Arbor stage III or IV, haemoglobin **under 12 g/dL**, involvement of **more than 4 nodal areas**, and elevated baseline serum lactate dehydrogenase **LDH**.

rows: Upfront chemoimmunotherapy indicated when GELF met

steps.tx: In patients presenting with asymptomatic, low tumour burden follicular lymphoma, an initial **watch-and-wait** surveillance strategy represents the established standard of care. Multiple randomized trials demonstrated that immediate intervention with chemotherapy or immunotherapy does not improve overall survival compared to delaying therapy until symptomatic progression, sparing patients from unnecessary treatment-related toxicities.

left.title: Watch-and-Wait Strategy
points: Indicated in low tumour burden without GELF criteria
Routine clinical and imaging surveillance every 3-6 months
Identical long-term overall survival vs immediate treatment
Completely preserves quality of life and immune health

right.title: GELF Criteria for Treatment
points: Any nodal mass >= 7 cm or 3 nodes >= 3 cm
Systemic B symptoms or malignant effusions

steps.tx: For symptomatic advanced follicular lymphoma, first-line chemoimmunotherapy utilizes **bendamustine plus rituximab** BR or **R-CHOP**. In the landmark German **StiL trial**, bendamustine plus rituximab demonstrated significant progression-free survival superiority over R-CHOP, prolonging median PFS from 31 months to 69 months while exhibiting lower rates of alopecia, neurotoxicity, and infectious complications.

rows: Superior PFS; no alopecia or neuropathy
Inferior progression-free survival compared to BR

steps.tx: Gastric mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue **MALT lymphoma** is an extranodal marginal zone lymphoma etiologically driven by chronic **Helicobacter pylori** infection. Chronic antigenic stimulation produces sustained clonal B-cell expansion. In early-stage disease without translocation alterations, antibiotic eradication therapy against Helicobacter pylori produces complete durable lymphoma remission in over 75% of patients.

steps.tx: Endoscopy shows thickened **nodular mucosa** along enlarged gastric folds, with forceps at a **biopsy site** over the diseased area. The inset shows dense lymphoid cells crowding the glands, matching **extranodal marginal zone** lymphoma after chronic **Helicobacter pylori** stimulation. Recognising this link matters because early disease often melts away after antibiotic cure of the infection rather than chemotherapy.
steps.say: This endoscopy shows swollen nodular folds in the stomach with a biopsy being taken, and the inset confirms a dense lymphoid infiltrate of MALT lymphoma. Chronic Helicobacter pylori infection drives this extranodal marginal zone lymphoma. In early disease without adverse genetics, clearing the infection alone can produce lasting remission, so biopsy plus testing for the organism guides care.

vis.alt: Endoscopy shows nodular gastric folds at biopsy with a lymphoid infiltrate inset.
vis.caption: Nodular folds link chronic infection to lymphoma. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma **Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia** is characterized by bone marrow infiltration by neoplastic B cells and plasma cells producing monoclonal IgM paraprotein. Over 90% of cases carry the signature activating **MYD88 L265P** somatic mutation, which triggers constitutive downstream IRAK-TRAF6 and BTK signalling, making oral BTK inhibitors ibrutinib and zanubrutinib highly effective therapeutic agents.

left.title: MYD88 L265P Mutation
points: High objective response rates to ibrutinib
Essential diagnostic differentiator from IgM myeloma

right.title: CXCR4 Mutations (WHIM-Like)
points: Co-occurs with MYD88 in approx. 30% to 40%
Confers relative resistance to BTK inhibitors
Delayed time to major response under therapy

steps.tx: Histological **transformation** of indolent follicular lymphoma into aggressive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma occurs at a rate of 2% to 3% per year. Transformation is clinically heralded by rapid localized lymph node enlargement, new B symptoms, hypercalcaemia, or soaring serum **LDH**. Confirmation requires an immediate excisional biopsy of the most FDG-avid lymph node on PET-CT scan.

steps.tx: Whole body scans contrast faint background **indolent nodes** with one intensely avid enlarging abdominal mass. This discordant uptake flags **histologic transformation** of follicular lymphoma toward aggressive **large cell** disease. Biopsy of the brightest node confirms the shift and resets treatment toward curative chemoimmunotherapy.
steps.say: The left and right views show many small low uptake nodes from known follicular lymphoma plus a single very bright bulky abdominal mass. Such a mismatch in brightness and size suggests transformation to diffuse large B cell disease. The teaching point is to sample the most avid enlarging node for histology, since proof of transformation changes therapy from watchful or gentle care to aggressive lymphoma treatment.

vis.alt: Whole body scans show faint widespread nodes with one intensely bright enlarging abdominal mass.
vis.caption: One bright mass among faint nodes signals transformation. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Bispecific CD20/CD3 T-cell engaging antibody **Mosunetuzumab** redirects endogenous cytotoxic T cells to eliminate malignant B cells. Approved for relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma after two or more prior systemic therapy lines, mosunetuzumab delivers fixed-duration therapy with complete response rates exceeding 60%, providing deep durable remissions without requiring complex cellular therapy manufacturing.
